title: Scaffold generalization and robustness of solubility model comparisons
amendment_policy: Any change after the first benchmark run must increment schema_version and be recorded in docs/PHASE6D_PLAN.md (Amendments). The MD5 of this file is recorded in every run output.

data.target_column: measured log solubility in mols per litre
forbidden_columns: ESOL predicted log solubility in mols per litre

identity.rule: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES of the whitespace-stripped input (src.cross_validation.canonical_identity_group)

murcko.rule: Bemis–Murcko scaffold SMILES; acyclic molecules use canonical SMILES (src.cross_validation.scaffold_group, Phase 4 rule)

generic.rule: MurckoScaffold.MakeScaffoldGeneric applied to the Bemis–Murcko scaffold; acyclic molecules use canonical SMILES

nonbenzene_scaffold_cv.test_population: all molecules whose Murcko group is not c1ccccc1 (874 rows, 583 groups)
nonbenzene_scaffold_cv.description: Each non-benzene molecule is predicted once per repeat by a model trained on all benzene molecules plus the other four non-benzene folds.

benzene_holdout.description: Single deterministic split; repeating it would only duplicate an identical fold.

generic_nonblock_scaffold_cv.test_population: all molecules outside generic group C1CCCCC1 (817 rows, 481 groups)

composite_out_of_fold.definition: sqrt((sum of benzene-holdout squared errors + sum over non-benzene molecules of repeat-averaged squared errors) / 1128)
composite_out_of_fold.label_in_reports: Composite out-of-fold result (benzene holdout + non-benzene scaffold CV); not a single cross-validation estimate

inner_cv.splitter: BalancedGroupKFold over the outer-training groups, excluding the protocol's block group
inner_cv.block_group_handling: the protocol's block group (benzene or generic C1CCCCC1), when present in outer training, is placed in every inner training fold and never in an inner validation fold
inner_cv.splits_passed_as: explicit list of (train_index, test_index) so that validation-fold sizes are known
inner_cv.selection_metric: molecule-weighted pooled RMSE = sqrt(sum_k n_k * RMSE_k^2 / sum_k n_k), equal to sqrt(total squared error / total validation molecules)
inner_cv.tie_breaking: lowest candidate index in ParameterGrid order

metrics.per_repeat_pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean over test molecules of squared error) for each repeat
metrics.repeat_averaged_rmse: sqrt(mean over molecules of (mean over repeats of squared error)); each molecule contributes once
metrics.fold_averaged_rmse: unweighted mean of outer-fold RMSE values; reported for continuity with Phase 6C
metrics.r2_policy: reported for whole protocols only; not reported within scaffold families

primary_contrast.sign_convention: positive means XGBoost has lower RMSE

secondary_contrasts.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the secondary contrasts

statistics.exploratory_contrasts: all remaining model pairs, every other protocol, every family and every sensitivity variant; intervals reported without significance claims

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protocol grouping label (Murcko or generic group) of test molecules
bootstrap.unit_of_observation: molecule, with squared errors averaged over repeats before resampling
bootstrap.p_value: two-sided percentile bootstrap p = min(1, 2 * min(P(delta* <= 0), P(delta* >= 0)))
bootstrap.single_split_protocols: benzene_holdout and generic_block_holdout use a molecule-level bootstrap within the held-out block, conditional on the single training set; reported as descriptive

decision_rule.label: practically equivalent at delta = 0.05, conditional on the bootstrap assumptions

decision_rule.condition: 95% CI excludes 0 and lies entirely beyond +delta or -delta
decision_rule.label: difference larger than delta
difference detected; magnitude relative to delta uncertain

phase6c_continuity_test.method: Nadeau–Bengio corrected resampled t-test on distinct outer folds
phase6c_continuity_test.role: continuity only; not used for conclusions

families.interval_method: molecule bootstrap within named families; cluster bootstrap by Murcko or identity group within aggregate families

S1.description: remove the structurally indistinguishable hexitol pair

S2.description: collapse each identity-duplicate group to one row with the mean target; drop groups whose target range exceeds 0.5 LogS
S2.requirement: descriptor values must be identical within each collapsed group; abort otherwise

sensitivity.subset_rescoring: S0 predictions are also scored on the S1 and S2 molecule subsets
sensitivity.robustness_criterion: the primary contrast receives the same decision-rule label under S0, S1 and S2

model_seed_check.reported: primary-contrast statistic for each of random_state 42-45 and its range

grid_boundary_check.definition: selected value equals the minimum or maximum of a numeric grid dimension with at least two values
grid_boundary_check.action_if_flagged: report only; grids are not extended within Phase 6D

exploratory_analyses.error_floor: within-group target variance of rows sharing identical six-descriptor vectors; floor RMSE = sqrt(within-group sum of squares / 1128)
exploratory_analyses.descriptor_distance: Euclidean distance from each test molecule to its nearest outer-training molecule in descriptor space standardized on the outer-training fold; Spearman correlation with absolute error per model
exploratory_analyses.structural_similarity: maximum Tanimoto similarity (Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits) of each test molecule to its outer-training set; summarized by family, with acyclic molecules reported separately

runtime.action_if_exceeded: stop and report; do not reduce folds, repeats or grids without approval

outputs.run_id: UTC timestamp + first 8 characters of this config's MD5
outputs.overwrite_policy: refuse if the run directory exists
outputs.tracked_format: JSON only (CSV files are ignored by .gitignore)
outputs.environment_capture: pip freeze and library versions written to each run

protected_files_md5.check: verified before and after every run; abort on mismatch before writing outputs

environment.pending_change: pin scipy==1.18.1 in requirements.txt during implementation
